a: git status shows staged, unstaged, and untracked files.
git log --oneline --graph is a compact history view.
git diff --staged shows what is already in the index.
git restore file discards unstaged changes to that file.
--soft moves HEAD but keeps changes staged.
--mixed (default) unstages but keeps working tree changes.
--hard discards commits and working tree changes — destructive.
git pull --rebase replays your commits on top of upstream.
